Column definitions for the table

props.description: Si el campo es obligatorio (muestra asterisco rojo)

props.description: If true, prefixes the title with "Edit " instead of "Create " (only for 'form' variant)

props.description: If true, disables the automatic "Create/Edit" prefix in 'form' variant

props.description: Component or tag used to render leaf links (defaults to a plain anchor)

props.description: Loading text shown when loading is true

props.description: An error message. Changes select to error state.

props.description: Hint text to display below the select

props.description: Property to use as the label if options are objects

props.description: Property to use as the value if options are objects. Can be a string key or a reduce function. If not provided, the whole object is returned.
